phrase.zh: 移动的磁场，唤起流动的电。
phrase.en: A changing magnetic field can stir a current.

visual.zh: 风格化人物站在铜线圈与发光弧线旁，把实验中看不见的感应画成流动的路径。线圈和仪表并非历史实验的精确复原。
visual.en: A stylized figure stands by coils and luminous arcs, turning invisible induction into moving paths. Apparatus and meter are not exact reconstructions of the experiment.

background.zh: 法拉第在 1831 年的实验中发现，改变穿过线圈的磁作用会引起短暂电流。他的感应研究成为发电机和变压器的基础；图中持续发亮的线条不表示电流会在静止磁场中无条件流动。
background.en: In 1831 Faraday found a transient current when magnetic conditions through a coil changed. His induction work underlies generators and transformers; the glowing lines do not imply a current flows unconditionally in a static magnetic field.
